summary.text: An attack on Dr. Amy Acton, the Democratic nominee for governor of Ohio, who escaped harm, prompted a same-day show of solidarity from House Democrats framed as political violence. It remains one day deep: five posts by five members on September 6, then nothing on September 7, when the press cycle turned to unrelated items. No one leads it — @RepRaskin, @RepGregLandsman, @RepScholten, @RepShontelBrown and @RoKhanna each posted once, Raskin's solidarity message the most visible. Framing held to "Amy Acton" and "political violence"; with a single day of activity there is no shift to report, and status stays provisional. Open: whether it recurs, broadens into a public-safety argument, or finds an owner.
